neighbours.label: the spelling piece 'ym' after 'th' in thymus/thymine words (th|ym|-), not 'ym' elsewhere
fire: Doctors removed the enlarged thymus during the chest surgery.
Radioactive thymidine was used to measure cell division in the samples.
Immature thymocytes are tested for self-reactivity before release.
The child was born with a small thymic shadow on the X-ray.
Mouthwash often contains thymol as an antiseptic ingredient.
Ultraviolet light can fuse two adjacent thymine bases in DNA.
In infants the Thymus is relatively large compared to adults.
Researchers grew thymic tissue from stem cells in the lab.
quiet: Doctors removed the enlarged thyroid during the neck surgery.
Radioactive iodine was used to measure gland activity in the samples.
Immature lymphocytes are tested for self-reactivity before release.
The child was born with a small heart murmur on the exam.
Mouthwash often contains menthol as a cooling ingredient.
Ultraviolet light can damage adjacent cytosine bases in DNA.
In infants the liver is relatively large compared to adults.
Researchers grew enzymes from yeast cells in the lab.

notes: Probe: thymus 0.896, thymol 0.769, thymine 0.662 (all peak on 'ym'); Judah 'ah' 0.518 and Tiber 'iber' 0.293 are secondary; zymogen 'ym' 0.016, so 'ym' needs the preceding 'th'. Lymph nodes 0.131, thyroid 0.055. Tokenizer: thymic, thymidine, thymocytes, Thymus all split th|ym|...
